title_patterns_that_work: I Checked If [Brand] Is A Scam... (The Truth)
Is [Brand] Actually Legit? (I Checked The Data)
Is [Brand] Legit or a [Category] Scam? (The Real Ratings)
title_patterns_to_avoid: Overly technical or niche queries (e.g., 'Is [Brand] Installing a TLS Backdoor?')
Obscure B2B/developer utilities with zero search demand (e.g., 'Is Ax-check.com Legit?')
Weak negative hooks lacking emotional charge (e.g., 'I Checked [Brand]… Don't Buy Yet')
Medical/wellness efficacy queries without scam/drama angle (e.g., 'Does [Product] Actually Work?')
notes: Shorts addressing active consumer skepticism ('Scam or Legit') on mass-market money apps (Cashify, Sweatcoin, Honeygain) and popular marketplace platforms (StubHub, DHgate, StockX) drastically outperform median views (17.0). Niche technical audits, low-search developer tools, and generic product efficacy checks fail to find an audience.
